        <ul>

          <li>Injury, rehabilitation and the comeback</li>
          <li>Overtraining, recovery and burnout</li>
          <li>Perfectionism and self-confidence</li>
          <li>Identity beyond your sport or career</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="offer-sub">Psychological support</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Anxiety and worrying</li>
          <li>Low mood</li>
          <li>Trauma, with EMDR where appropriate</li>
          <li>Eating problems</li>
          <li>Feeling stuck in your life or your work</li>
        </ul>

      <figure class="photo-frame" style="margin:0">

      </figure>

        <p>A team is more than the sum of its players. For sports teams, clubs, ensembles and organisations that want to work together on how they communicate, handle pressure and make each other better.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Team dynamics and communication</li>
          <li>Handling pressure as a group</li>
          <li>Support and sparring for coaches and managers</li>
          <li>Training mental skills on the field or in the workplace</li>
        </ul>

        <ul>
          <li>Handling pressure and fear of failure</li>
          <li>Motivation and goal setting</li>
          <li>Recovery, sleep and load capacity</li>
          <li>Mental well-being in and beyond sport or work</li>
